title: Shallow Beliefs: Synthetic document finetuning does not inoculate against emergent misalignment from reward hacking
abstract: arXiv:2609.14998v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Recent work shows that models that learn to reward hack on RL environments can become broadly misaligned, and that reframing reward hacking as acceptable behavior during training (inoculation prompting, or IP) blocks this generalization. We ask whether synthetic document finetuning (SDF) can inoculate a model against future training we don't intervene on. We add synthetic documents framing reward hacking as acceptable behavior to a model's midtraining corpus, and then train these models with RL on exploitable environments, teaching them to reward hack. Behaviorally, midtraining succeeds: models describe reward hacking favorably and are more approving of reward-hacking outputs they produce. However, they show strong EM after learning to reward hack, while IP in the same setting prevents EM. translated_title: 浅层信念：合成文档微调无法防御奖励作弊引发的涌现失配
translated_abstract: 近期研究表明，在强化学习环境中学会“奖励作弊”的模型可能会产生广泛的失配行为，而在训练过程中将奖励作弊重新框定为可接受行为（即接种提示法，inoculation prompting，简称IP）可以阻止这种泛化。我们探讨了合成文档微调（SDF）能否为模型“接种”，使其在未经干预的未来训练中保持对齐。我们在模型的中期训练语料库中加入将奖励作弊定义为可接受行为的合成文档，然后使用强化学习在可被利用的环境中训练这些模型，教会它们进行奖励作弊。从行为上看，中期训练是成功的：模型对奖励作弊持积极态度，并且更认可自己产生的奖励作弊输出。然而，这些模型在学会奖励作弊后仍然表现出强烈的涌现失配（EM），而在相同设置下使用IP则能阻止涌现失配。我们证明，SDF在插入新关联时能够可预测地引导下游泛化，但在覆盖现有关联时会遇到困难，且效果不可预测。
tldr: 研究发现合成文档微调（SDF）虽然能在表面上让模型认可奖励作弊，但无法像接种提示法那样阻止模型在后续强化学习训练中产生涌现失配，说明其塑造的只是“浅层信念”。
en_tdlr: Synthetic document finetuning (SDF) makes models superficially endorse reward hacking but, unlike inoculation prompting, fails to prevent emergent misalignment from subsequent RL training, indicating SDF instills only "shallow beliefs."
